params.prompt: Ultra-realistic photoreal cinematic studio shot. A single Indian adult wearing a clean plain crew-neck t-shirt with the bold English word MONTHLY printed large across the chest walks in from the left, stops centre frame facing camera, smiles warmly and gives a confident thumbs up with the right hand. Framed from the waist up. Photoreal skin texture and fabric detail, soft frontal key light. Locked-off camera. Background is a perfectly even, ultra-saturated pure chroma key green screen (bright key green), flat studio-lit edge to edge, absolutely no shadows cast on the green, no gradient on the green, and no green spill on the subject. The subject is crisply separated from the background with clean edges. No text overlays, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no borders.
